notes.title: An early version of Re-Frozen Edition is available now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31150884/4e04e470ad165dd3bf04000703bbc3c0d7d2848b.jpg[/img]

A great job has been done on the visuals, sound, optimization and small gameplay elements. This is just an early version of a big update — a lot of new features are coming soon.

If you find some bug, inform us about it in the comments, thanks to you we have deprived the game of many problems and now we are ready to work more!

[b]Thank you for your support![/b]

notes.title: Perfomance Patch
notes.notes:
The project has been ported and adapted for a new version of the game engine. Performance should increase significantly.

[i]At first there may be bugs - be sure to write about them, they will be fixed.[/i]

Thanks!

notes.title: Heat Guardian is live!
notes.notes:
The time has finally come! Heat Guardian is finished and ready for you to try. Hope this will be an exciting adventure for you. And remember – stay warm!

Enjoy!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31150884/a3ee450e32dc20b981c56ab4a2fa298fed4d8b16.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Heat Guardian release date and the launch trailer
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Great news today! Heat Guardian is out on May 10. In just a week you’ll be able to explore the endless winter and face its dangers. 

Meanwhile check out the game’s launch trailer. And thanks to everyone who supported Heat Guardian during the development. Your comments, tips and patience helped and inspired so much!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8fPApTf13-k
